::: {.block title="2. Predictions in coastal regions"}
Measured as SOCA2024 validates its open-ocean product, CHLA-Z does about as well (r²) on the
continental slope as in the open ocean (@tbl-coastal), and it predicts integrated Chl *a*
best on the slope (@fig-coastal). On the shelf it captures the surface but not the profile:
predictions are often too flat, and few whole shelf profiles exist.

| | r² (log10) | Slope | MAPD | RMSD (mg m⁻³) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| SOCA2024 (open ocean) | 0.83 | 0.82 | 30% | 0.19 |
| CHLA-Z open ocean | 0.68 | 0.69 | 43% | 0.22 |
| CHLA-Z slope | 0.67 | 0.71 | 44% | 0.56 |
| CHLA-Z shelf | 0.30 | 0.42 | 45% | 0.75 |

: Skill on held-out data with SOCA2024`’`{=typst}s validation metrics, which pool all depths together: r² and slope from a regression of predicted on observed log10 Chl *a*; MAPD, median absolute percent difference; RMSD, root mean square difference. SOCA2024 row from its own validation. {#tbl-coastal}
